mainEntity.name: What travel insurance plans are available for group members?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel insurance plans for group members traveling together works similarly to any travel insurance plan, providing coverage for certain events or losses, which may include trip cancellation, lost or delayed baggage, medical expenses during the trip and more. Without a travel insurance plan, travelers may be at risk for paying additional fees without reimbursement for certain unexpected circumstances, which can be frustrating when you’re splitting the cost of a vacation.

mainEntity.name: What do travel insurance plans for group members cover?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Look for a plan that has the coverage and benefit limits your group members need. Popular plan features include:

- Medical expense coverage

- Pre-existing medical condition exclusion waiver (if purchased within 15 days of initial trip deposit) – great if you’re traveling with grandparents or family members who may have health conditions

- Trip cancellation/interruption coverage

- Missed flight connection assistance

- Baggage coverage

- Car rental coverage (optional add-on coverage)

- Cancel For Any Reason (optional add-on coverage available with certain plans)

- Wedding bundle – coverage for those attending a destination wedding

- Emergency travel assistance – specialized representatives are available 24/7 to help

mainEntity.name: Do I need a travel insurance plan for group members?

acceptedAnswer.text: A travel insurance plan can be a great option to help protect your travel investment, which may be essential when traveling in a group. It may even be a requirement if your group is traveling with a third-party tour group. When you are a group traveler, you’re sharing the stress and responsibility of costs and managing logistics. A travel insurance plan can help with a variety of services, from getting help with flight delays and cancelations, lost baggage to roadside assistance. All of Travel Guard’s travel insurance plans come with access to our specially trained representatives for 24/7 emergency travel assistance so your group can focus on the fun while Travel Guard can help with unexpected mishaps.

mainEntity.name: Which Travel Guard insurance plan is best for my group trip members?

acceptedAnswer.text: No matter the type of trip you’re planning, our Preferred Plan is a great place for any traveler to start. It includes popular services and coverages such as certain medical expense coverage, trip delay and baggage coverage. However, you may want to consider our Deluxe Plan as an option as it has higher benefit limits and concierge services to help plan and schedule excursions.

mainEntity.name: Can I get travel insurance plans for group members taking a cruise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cruises can be the perfect vacation for groups looking to travel – there’s something for everyone to enjoy. A Travel Guard travel insurance plan allows you to choose the coverage you need. Planning some adventure sports on your cruise? Make sure you have Travel Guard’s Adventure Sports Bundle .

mainEntity.name: Will a travel insurance plan cover seniors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, seniors can be covered under a Travel Guard travel insurance plan though it may increase the price of your quote. Additionally, when getting coverage with Travel Guard, be sure to purchase your travel insurance soon after booking your trip. In doing so, you’ll qualify for the pre-existing condition exclusion waiver, which means you’ll have coverage for most pre-existing conditions for certain losses due to pre-existing medical conditions that would otherwise create an exclusion to coverage under your travel insurance plan.

mainEntity.name: Why book your travel insurance plan through Travel Guard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel Guard offers a variety of comprehensive travel insurance plan options to help protect your group vacation. Our emergency services team ensures you won’t be handling certain crises by yourself. Plus, our add-ons can help customize your travel insurance plan, so you’ll be able to enjoy your vacation knowing your travel investment is more protected.
